title.zh: 传递在其起约束之处独立：去掉给予者的一条依存，其余每个前提与有限不变而传递失效，所以去掉依存时保持的规律都推不出它；交换的读法加上“取用即依存”推出它，二者都需要
title.en: Transmission is independent wherever it binds: dropping one dependence of the giver keeps every other premise and finiteness and breaks it, so no law kept by dropping a dependence derives it; a reading of the exchange with drawing being depending derives it, each needed

claim.zh: 去掉 g 在步 t 对 c 的依存（Web.drop、World.drop）不改变任何水平、活动、取用、所需与流，保持活动需要支持（Web.drop_dependent）、其余七个前提与有限（World.drop_holds、World.drop_finite），并在后代依存 c 的每次世系上使传递对每个 δ 都失效（Flow.drop_untransmitted、World.drop_untransmitting）。所以满足其余七个前提、传递在其中起约束的每个世界都有一个邻居，去掉一条依存，满足除传递外的全部（World.drop_but）；有限的孵化与它的邻居就是这样一对（World.finiteHatch_pair）。一般的界限：在去掉依存时保持、且推出传递的关于世界的条件，推出传递不起约束（World.vacuous_of_drop_invariant）。交换的读法是这样的条件：关系项在第一个立足之步只依存每个给予它者在给予之步所取用的（Flow.DependsOnDrawn），或跨该步所取的（Flow.DependsOnFed；只有活跃者取用且只从所取用者取时它给出前者，Flow.dependsOnDrawn_of_fed）；两者在去掉依存时都保持（Flow.DependsOnDrawn.drop、Flow.DependsOnFed.drop），所以有限、其余七个前提与取用的读法推不出传递（World.drawn_not_enough）。加上一条要求依存的规律，在给予者处取用 c 即依存 c（Web.DrawingDepends），读法给出承继（Flow.inherits_of_drawn、Flow.inherits_of_fed）。有限、平衡、耗散的世界中每个水平至多是第一步所立者的总量（World.Finite.level_le）；活动需要支持且每个关系项体现时，所需之界在水平的界之内成立（Flow.needsWithin_of_embodied），所以在满足平衡、耗散、体现与活动需要支持的有限世界中，传递恰是承继（World.transmitting_iff_inherits，有水平之界时 World.transmitting_iff_inherits_bounded），读法加上链接给出传递（World.transmitting_of_drawn、World.transmitting_of_fed），不是空的：亲代也依存自身的有限孵化中这些都成立且传递起约束（World.bearingHatch_derived）。二者都需要（World.drawn_and_link_needed）：从有限孵化去掉亲代对食物的依存，读法成立而链接不成立（World.drawn_without_link）；在 novel 中链接对亲代成立，没有东西取用亲代，而读法不成立（World.link_without_drawn）。不用公理。
claim.en: Dropping g's dependence on c at step t (Web.drop, World.drop) changes no level, activity, drawing, need or flow, keeps activity needing support (Web.drop_dependent), the seven other premises and finiteness (World.drop_holds, World.drop_finite), and breaks transmission for every δ at any descent whose descendant depends on c (Flow.drop_untransmitted, World.drop_untransmitting). So every world meeting the seven other premises in which transmission binds has a neighbour, one dependence dropped, meeting all but transmission (World.drop_but); the finite hatch and its neighbour are such a pair (World.finiteHatch_pair). The general boundary: a condition on worlds kept by dropping a dependence and implying transmission implies that transmission does not bind (World.vacuous_of_drop_invariant). A reading of the exchange is such a condition: a relatum depends at its first standing step only on what each relatum giving to it drew on at the giving step (Flow.DependsOnDrawn), or took from across it (Flow.DependsOnFed, which gives the first where only active relata take and only from what they draw on, Flow.dependsOnDrawn_of_fed); both are kept by dropping a dependence (Flow.DependsOnDrawn.drop, Flow.DependsOnFed.drop), so finiteness, the seven other premises and the reading of drawing do not give transmission (World.drawn_not_enough). With one law requiring dependence, at the giver, that drawing on c is depending on it (Web.DrawingDepends), the reading gives inheritance (Flow.inherits_of_drawn, Flow.inherits_of_fed). A finite, balanced, dissipative world bounds every level by the total standing at the first step (World.Finite.level_le); with activity needing support and every relatum embodied the need half holds within a bound on levels (Flow.needsWithin_of_embodied), so in a finite world meeting balance, dissipation, embodiment and activity needing support transmission is exactly inheritance (World.transmitting_iff_inherits; with a bound on levels, World.transmitting_iff_inherits_bounded), and the reading with the link gives transmission (World.transmitting_of_drawn, World.transmitting_of_fed), not vacuously: in the finite hatch whose parent also depends on itself all of these hold and transmission binds (World.bearingHatch_derived). Each is needed (World.drawn_and_link_needed): with the parent's dependence on the food dropped from the finite hatch, the reading holds and the link fails (World.drawn_without_link); in novel the link holds of the parent, on which nothing draws, and the reading fails (World.link_without_drawn). No axiom.

hypotheses.zh: 独立与界限对每个世界陈述；推出需要有限、平衡、耗散、体现、活动需要支持、取用的读法与链接，各自公开。
hypotheses.en: Independence and the boundary are stated for every world; the derivation needs finiteness, balance, dissipation, embodiment, activity needing support, the reading of drawing and the link, each supplied openly.

hypotheses.zh: 链接（取用即依存）是充分而非必要的：在有限孵化中亲代取用自身而不依存自身，传递仍成立。
hypotheses.en: The link (drawing is depending) is sufficient, not necessary: in the finite hatch the parent draws on itself without depending on itself, and transmission holds there.

correspondence.zh: P84（工作板），按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“move towards 100%”。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：其余七个前提只限制依存，从不要求某个依存；传递要求给予者的依存，所以它不能从它们推出，任何推出都要一条要求依存存在的规律。取用即依存是这样一条规律的候选；是否采用它，或采用别的形成的规律，属于 Ren。见整合文档 §105。
correspondence.en: P84 (work board), following Ren's ‘move towards 100%’ of 12 October 2026. Reading (the AI's, pending Ren): the seven other premises only limit dependence and never require one; transmission requires the giver's, so it cannot follow from them, and any derivation needs a law requiring some dependence to exist. Drawing being depending is a candidate for such a law; whether it, or another law of forming, is adopted is Ren's. See the integration document §105.

detail.zh: 复用 Premise、MeetsAllBut、finiteHatch、novel 与 novel_but；把 novel 的单个见证推广到传递起约束的每个世界。
detail.en: Reuses Premise, MeetsAllBut, finiteHatch, novel and novel_but; generalizes the single witness novel to every world in which transmission binds.

output.zh: 八个前提、见证世界与传递的独立（一个见证）。
output.en: The eight premises, the witness worlds and the independence of transmission (one witness).

input.zh: 在传递起约束的每个世界旁都有一个邻居。
input.en: A neighbour beside every world in which transmission binds.

conditions.zh: 其余七个前提；传递起约束。
conditions.en: The seven other premises; transmission binding.

detail.zh: 复用传递的分解（transmitsWithin_iff）与所需之界的推出。
detail.en: Reuses the split of transmission (transmitsWithin_iff) and the derivation of the need half.

output.zh: 传递恰是承继加所需之界。
output.en: Transmission is exactly inheritance with the need within a bound.

input.zh: 有限世界中传递恰是承继。
input.en: In finite worlds transmission is exactly inheritance.

conditions.zh: 有限、平衡、耗散、体现、活动需要支持。
conditions.en: Finiteness, balance, dissipation, embodiment, activity needing support.

detail.zh: 回答其 next_delta：传递能否由给予与依存的形成推出。
detail.en: Answers its next_delta: whether transmission can be derived from how giving and dependence form.

detail.zh: drawn_without_link 与 link_without_drawn：读法与链接各自都不给出承继。
detail.en: drawn_without_link and link_without_drawn: neither the reading nor the link gives inheritance alone.

limitations.zh: 只对离散步、自然数的量陈述；独立在传递起约束的世界上陈述；链接是充分而非必要的；推出不是对每个世界的，需要有限与所列前提；所需之界是对水平的粗界；是否采用取用即依存属于 Ren；名称是 AI 的表述，由 Ren 定（drop、DependsOnDrawn、DrawingDepends 等）。
limitations.en: Stated for discrete steps and natural-number amounts; independence is stated on worlds in which transmission binds; the link is sufficient, not necessary; the derivation is not for every world, needing finiteness and the listed premises; the need bound is a coarse bound on levels; whether drawing is depending is adopted is Ren's; the names are the AI's wording, for Ren to choose (drop, DependsOnDrawn, DrawingDepends and others).

validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 64 theorems of Becoming.Transmission all have empty axiom reports, among them Web.drop, World.drop, Web.drop_dependent, World.drop_holds, World.drop_finite, Flow.drop_untransmitted, World.drop_untransmitting, World.drop_but, World.finiteHatch_pair, World.vacuous_of_drop_invariant, Flow.DependsOnDrawn, Flow.DependsOnFed, Web.DrawingDepends, World.drawn_not_enough, Flow.inherits_of_drawn, Flow.inherits_of_fed, World.Finite.level_le, World.transmitting_iff_inherits, World.transmitting_of_drawn, World.transmitting_of_fed, World.bearingHatch_derived, World.drawn_and_link_needed, World.drawn_without_link and World.link_without_drawn. The same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §105 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.

next_delta.zh: 一条必要且充分的形成规律（链接只是充分的）；水平无界时的推出（有界时已给出：World.transmitting_iff_inherits_bounded）；是否采用取用即依存（Ren）。
next_delta.en: A law of forming that is necessary as well as sufficient (the link is only sufficient); the derivation where levels are unbounded (with a bound it is given: World.transmitting_iff_inherits_bounded); whether drawing is depending is adopted (Ren).
